method: Sequential evidence passes followed by separate refute-first rereads; no independent subagent audit or live app audit in this design task.
verdict: Build JOVRA Studio as an optional staged expansion: start with one real match and verified films, then reviewed two-view sync, then six-device and cloud activation.
strengths: Existing native/local-first JOVRA architecture and provenance
IDC project lock and written edit-plan workflow
Separate editor's explicit source mapping, dry-run default and export verification

confirmed.title: The attached archive is a workflow pack, not the proposed tennis renderer
confirmed.detail: All 17 files inspected; assembly is hook plus frozen frame and audio; no executable multi-angle engine in the ZIP.
confirmed.fix: New source-bound tennis EDL and renderer adapter.
confirmed.refutation: Reread ZIP manifest and README/NOTICE. The separate existing editor provides executable code, but it is not bundled or integrated in this archive.

confirmed.title: Existing mapped renderer needs phone-media normalization and new editing capabilities
confirmed.detail: Strict CFR, dimensions/FPS, zero rotation and frame-clock constraints; it does not discover sync or implement all requested edits.
confirmed.fix: Preserve constraints; normalize proxies and add a versioned JOVRA adapter.
confirmed.refutation: Reread production_preview.py limits, validate_mapping and frame-clock path; bounded assembly exists, so do not claim no executable editor exists.

confirmed.title: Database RLS alone does not protect private R2 media
confirmed.detail: Object access must be independently checked; presigned URLs are bearer capabilities until expiry.
confirmed.fix: Signing gateway with per-project/object/role authorization and short-lived capabilities.
confirmed.refutation: Reread R2 security considerations and Supabase RLS scope; no direct cross-provider RLS protection is documented.

confirmed.title: New backend-ready scope must be reconciled with the current no-backend ADR
confirmed.detail: ADR 0002 excludes a v1 cloud account/backend, while the latest user requests backend readiness and optional provisioning.
confirmed.fix: New scope-change ADR; offline foundation preserved.
confirmed.refutation: Latest user explicitly changes desired direction, so the old ADR is a history item, not a reason to reject the expansion.

refuted.claim: A Markdown-only attached suite means there is no reusable executable editor anywhere.
refuted.reason: Live filesystem inspection found the separate Remotion/FFmpeg project and source-mapping adapters; reuse remains proposed.

refuted.claim: Six views automatically give reliable 3D tennis metrics.
refuted.reason: Sync, calibration, correspondence and real benchmark evidence are separate requirements; this is not assumed by the design.

unverified: Six-phone sustained field capture and transport reliability
Actual user's old match; no video attached
Compute runtimes, margins and retail pricing
Current research-agent completion or foundation CI
Live editor integration, real app execution and store readiness
